title: When your bag does not arrive

all: Good. The agent will use the tag number to check the bag's status.

A.text: Should I wait for another carousel announcement first?
all: Should I wait for another carousel announcement first?

A.speaker: S
A.text: Ask the agent now, and they can tell you whether more bags are expected.
all: Ask the agent now, and they can tell you whether more bags are expected.

B.speaker: T
B.text: The system says my bag is delayed. Can I file a report here?
all: The system says my bag is delayed. Can I file a report here?

접수 번호를 보관하시고 신고서에 인쇄된 연락 방법을 이용해 주세요.

B.speaker: T
B.text: Does the report mean the bag has been permanently lost?

신고서를 작성하면 수하물이 영구적으로 분실되었다는 뜻인가요？
